make_or_buy_basis: Rail-application graphic film replaces masked colour-band painting on smooth cured GFRP and cowl surfaces; it never replaces steel primer/topcoat, laminate gelcoat, fire protection, labels, or sealants.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: UV-stable exterior gelcoat/paint, sealed cut edges, gasketed seams, and mixed-metal isolation
material_spec.form_factor: moulded cowl cast, solid flanges, local core in broad skins, potted inserts, and trim/repair coupons
material_spec.governing_standard: supplier laminate schedule plus project fire/smoke, coupon, and insert pull-out evidence
material_spec.grade_or_part_class: E-glass or basalt-fibre/vinyl-ester end-cowl laminate and insert kit
material_spec.nominal_section: laminate thickness, ply drop, core map, insert pattern, split line, and trim datum per LM3-BDY-155
material_spec.traceability: laminate batch, resin batch, cure record, insert pull-out record, adhesive batch, and coupon traceability

joining_methods: sealed, gasketed, bonded, or clipped interface as supplier envelope requires
process_spec.release_level: BID supplier-controlled process; OSR controls envelope and acceptance evidence

fit_gaps: Exact film, colour/ink, overlaminate, edge treatment, fire evidence, hot-climate durability and warranty territory remain to be selected and tested.
supplier_anchor.localisation: Print, plot, kit, apply, inspect and repair locally using the selected film/ink/overlaminate system; qualify a regional equivalent only as a complete system on the released LM3 base finish.
mandatory_equivalence: same or better released fit, mounting datums, connector keying and service envelope
same or better mass, load, duty-cycle, thermal, electrical and environmental ratings
same or better functional safety, fire, EMC, cybersecurity and applicable rail evidence
documented failure modes, maintenance intervals, spares and obsolescence route
first-article inspection plus component, subassembly and vehicle regression tests
signed design-authority substitution record preserving the original anchor and evidence hashes
supplier_anchor.release_boundary: A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.
